title: Marketplace SKU mapping sheet (AWS + GCP) → internal plans, meters, entitlements
content:
Last updated: 2025-02-09 (Talia)

Purpose
- Single source of truth for mapping Marketplace SKUs (AWS/GCP) to Redwood internal plan codes, billing meters, and entitlements.
- Used by: Engineering (entitlement mapping + metering), Partnerships (listing setup), Finance (invoice descriptions/revrec), Sales/SE/CS (what buyer gets).

Important conventions (per ADR)
- Marketplace SKU display names MUST match the pattern: "Redwood Inference – <Product> – <Tier> – <Billing Mode>".
- Internal plan_code is stable; marketplace identifiers can vary by cloud/region.
- Entitlements are additive; base SKU grants core access, add-ons grant feature flags + policy limits.
- Meter names in billing MUST match exactly (case-sensitive) to avoid reporting drift.

Assumptions / open questions
- AWS Hosted: contract is usage-based with metering for token in/out and embeddings. (Nadia/Cole to confirm final meter names.)
- GCP Hosted: same meters; GCP requires a single “usage reporting dimension” per listing item; we model 3 dimensions under one product where supported.
- Dedicated & Private SKUs are commit-based (monthly platform fee and/or reserved GPU capacity). Any overages handled via direct invoice (TBD) unless marketplace supports the dimension.
- Upgrades/downgrades: see PM-876 draft policy; current assumption = upgrades allowed within same family, downgrades handled at renewal to avoid mid-cycle entitlement churn.

Key: Columns
- internal_plan_code: what console/billing uses
- aws_sku_id / gcp_sku_id: listing item identifier (what we receive in entitlement events)
- aws_offer_id / gcp_product_id: marketplace product container id (used for listing setup)
- billing_meters: meters reported for usage-based; for commit SKUs list "platform_fee" / "reserved_capacity" as applicable
- entitlements_granted: internal entitlement ids set by mapping layer
- notes: constraints, edge cases, migration notes

TABLE E — Internal-only mapping helpers (NOT exposed in listings)
| internal_key | description | used_by | notes |

| entitlement_source:aws_marketplace | Marks entitlement created via AWS MP webhook ingestion | provisioning pipeline | Used for reporting + special retry semantics (idempotency key = aws_customer_identifier + sku_id). |
| entitlement_source:gcp_marketplace | Marks entitlement created via GCP MP procurement event | provisioning pipeline | GCP events sometimes arrive before org link step; keep in PENDING state until linked. |
| mp_org_link_state | NONE / PENDING / LINKED / ERROR | console wizard | Drives the in-console onboarding wizard state machine (DES-211). |

Edge cases / constraints (must be reflected in mapping layer + CS runbooks)
1) Multiple cloud accounts → one Redwood org
- Buyer may purchase from multiple AWS payer accounts (or multiple GCP billing accounts) and expect it to roll into one Redwood org.
- Policy: allow multiple “billing identities” linked to a single org, but enforce that each billing identity can only be linked to one org at a time.
- Support needs a safe relink path (SUP-18433 class). Provide audit trail.

2) Region mismatch
- Hosted API is multi-region; Dedicated/Private provisioning is region-bound.
- If buyer purchases Dedicated/Private in a region not currently supported for their desired deployment, console should surface: “Entitled, provisioning requires region selection / sales contact.”
- GCP validation can fail if buyer’s org policy restricts region; capture this in error messaging (SUP-18461 class).

3) Upgrades / downgrades
- Upgrades within Hosted family: Starter → Pro → Enterprise should be “effective immediately” for quotas/entitlements.
- Downgrades should be scheduled (end of billing cycle) to avoid breaking running workloads.
- Dedicated/Private changes typically require human review; treat as “request change” rather than automatic churn.

4) Add-on attach rules
- Add-ons should attach to any base SKU, but some combinations are nonsensical (e.g., retention without observability enabled).
- Mapping layer should allow the entitlement but UI should gate/configure the dependent features.

5) Metering consistency
- Hosted usage meters must remain stable: tokens_in, tokens_out, embeddings_units.
- If we introduce rerank units later, it must be a new meter (do not overload embeddings_units).

Implementation notes (for ENG-4401 / ENG-4406)
- Mapping table lives in code (versioned) + exported to Ops sheet for GTM review.
- Any change to aws_sku_id or gcp_sku_id requires:
  a) backward-compatible mapping for prior SKUs for at least 90 days
  b) an internal migration plan for existing marketplace buyers
  c) Finance review of invoice description strings
